compiled_state.description:
## Problem

`bedrock-spend-cap` can enforce on a spend figure that includes static seed rates or `UNKNOWN_RATE_PER_1K`, but the handler has no provenance flag telling consumers that the figure is partly estimated. That capability was cut from `3083-ada3` so the empirical-rate fix can stay focused.

## Current code facts

`_rate_for()` at `infra/terraform/bedrock-spend-cap/handler.py:226-274` returns a bare `float`. Its paths are empirical match at lines 261-263, seed at lines 265-267, input-derived empirical rate at lines 269-271, and fail-closed fallback at lines 273-274. The caller cannot distinguish those sources.

`_metered_spend()` at `handler.py:280-341` accumulates `total += units_1k * _rate_for(model_id, metric_name, rates)` at line 337 and returns only the numeric total at line 341. There is no accumulator for source provenance.

The handler saves state through `_save_state(state)` at `handler.py:143-144` and calls it at line 589. The return payload at `handler.py:590-600` includes dollar values and source status, but no estimated-rate field. WARNING notification text is built at `handler.py:550-559`; TRIP notification text is built at `handler.py:578-587`. Neither message identifies seed or fallback participation.

## Required change

Change `_rate_for()`'s return contract so callers receive both the numeric rate and a bounded source value such as `empirical`, `seed`, `empirical_scaled`, or `fallback`. Update every caller in this handler in the same patch.

Change `_metered_spend()` to accumulate both the numeric spend total and whether any component used `seed` or `fallback`. Preserve the existing numeric behavior for empirical and empirical-scaled rates.

Thread the provenance through the handler response payload, the saved SSM state dict, and the WARNING and TRIP `_notify` call sites. Use one field name consistently; `metered_estimated` is acceptable.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `_rate_for()` returns the numeric rate and a bounded source value.
- [ ] `_rate_for()` labels exact empirical matches as `empirical`.
- [ ] `_rate_for()` labels seed matches as `seed`.
- [ ] `_rate_for()` labels input-derived empirical matches as `empirical_scaled`.
- [ ] `_rate_for()` labels `UNKNOWN_RATE_PER_1K` fallback matches as `fallback`.
- [ ] `_metered_spend()` accumulates the existing numeric spend total.
- [ ] `_metered_spend()` reports estimated provenance when any component source is `seed`.
- [ ] `_metered_spend()` reports estimated provenance when any component source is `fallback`.
- [ ] The handler return payload includes `metered_estimated: true` when metered spend includes a seed rate.
- [ ] The handler return payload includes `metered_estimated: true` when metered spend includes `UNKNOWN_RATE_PER_1K`.
- [ ] The saved SSM state includes `metered_estimated: true` after a run whose metered spend includes a seed rate.
- [ ] The saved SSM state includes `metered_estimated: true` after a run whose metered spend includes `UNKNOWN_RATE_PER_1K`.
- [ ] WARNING SNS text includes `estimated` when warning spend includes a seed rate.
- [ ] TRIP SNS text includes `estimated` when trip spend includes `UNKNOWN_RATE_PER_1K`.
- [ ] `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest tests/infra/test_bedrock_spend_cap_handler.py -k estimated` exits 0.
- [ ] `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make verify` exits 0.

## Testing

During development run `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest tests/infra/test_bedrock_spend_cap_handler.py -k estimated`. Before push run `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest tests/infra/test_bedrock_spend_cap_handler.py`. Before Gerrit push run `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make verify`.

## Out of scope

Do not change the Claude Marketplace CE service filter in this ticket; `3083-ada3` owns that empirical-rate and authoritative-spend fix.
